assets.prompt: One final-evolution celestial guardian cat for the Lv10 tile, clearly more prestigious than the Lv9 galaxy aurora cat while belonging to the same collection. Exactly one full-body cat sitting upright and facing mostly forward, centered and fully visible, with a compact rounded body, round ears, tiny glossy dark eyes, a calm friendly expression, and a strong readable silhouette. Pearly white face, chest, and paws transition into deep midnight-blue ears, back, and curled tail; add a few large clean aurora color blocks in restrained violet, blue, and pink, elegant warm-gold celestial markings, and one small luminous diamond-shaped star mark centered on the forehead. Place one simple thin circular silver-gold aurora halo behind the head, clearly separated from the ears and body, with only a few large star points. Use a confident charcoal-to-silver outer contour, soft upper-left lighting, subtle hand-painted paper-grain texture, and restrained glow. Keep details broad and legible at 64-80 px. Preserve generous transparent padding around the complete silhouette. No floor, scenery, props, crown, wings, clothing, jewelry, text, numbers, letters, logo, watermark, multiple cats, duplicate body parts, clipped ears or tail, thin fur strands, busy star fields, neon bloom, photorealism, anime, or plastic 3D rendering.
